findings.claim: The Read-only pill span has neither whitespace-nowrap nor shrink-0, unlike the pending badge and balance beside it, so when the row runs out of space it can shrink and wrap its text between the hyphen, breaking 'Read-only' into 'Read-' and 'only', an effect made more visible by the leading-none style.

This wrapping can occur in practice because a chain only needs to be deployed and have queued transactions to show the pending badge, so a read-only chain can display both the pending badge and the Read-only pill together, increasing crowding in the row.

No tests were changed for this commit; the existing tests only check for the Inactive/Activating badge and would still pass even if the badge layout reverted to sitting under the name, so they do not cover the new position.
The isReadOnly branch of StatusBadge has no test coverage at all.

There is no Storybook story showing an expanded multi-chain row with an undeployed or read-only chain; the existing MixedActivationStates story only covers single-chain rows, leaving no visual check of the new layout.

The PR description should carry forward the reasoning given in the commit message (that the icon-only badge from a prior change looked orphaned) and include design sign-off if available, since this is a visible behavior change.
